# AWS icon index

Generated by `scripts/build_icon_index.sh`. Do not edit by hand — names come
from the PascalCase filename + `scripts/fixtures/acronyms-aws.tsv`; optional
per-stem overrides live in `scripts/fixtures/icon-index-tags-aws.tsv`.

> AWS Architecture Icons are licensed **CC-BY-ND 2.0** (NoDerivatives). The
> PNGs in `dist/AWS/` are redistributed **byte-identical** to upstream — do
> NOT resize, recolor, crop, or re-encode them (a resize is a derivative and
> is forbidden). See `dist/AWS/USAGE-RULES.txt`.

Each row points at a usable PNG path (flat per-category, all 64x64). Find an
icon by name, category, or tag:

```bash
grep -i 'lambda' dist/AWS/INDEX.md          # by name
grep -F '`compute`' dist/AWS/INDEX.md       # by tag
grep -F '| Compute |' dist/AWS/INDEX.md     # by category
```
